capabilities: Embed code from a file by relative or absolute path in a code block
Select which lines to preview using numbers, text search, or RegExp
Highlight specific lines, ranges, or matched text
Configure per-block options (start, end, highlight, linenumber) via YAML
Include or exclude files and paths globally in plugin settings
disambiguation: Not a code editor or linter; it renders read-only snippets from vault files inside code blocks.
extras: README notes that the watchAlias and watchCode options may affect performance; examples are provided as an example.zip to open as a vault, and a Chinese version of the README exists.
intentEvidence: Code language is extname by path
problem: Obsidian code blocks only show code typed inline; there is no built-in way to display excerpts from actual files in the vault.

relations.evidence: linenumber, highlight Based on obsidian-better-codeblock his implementation

summary: Code-block renderer that previews code from vault files by path, with line ranges, highlighting, and line numbers.
